{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Deathknell''''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that appeared in ''[[Xim at Vontor]]'', a [[Holodrama/Legends|holoplay]] that was written by the [[holowright]] [[Peshosloc]]. The play portrayed the ''Deathknell'' as being the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] during the [[Third Battle of Vontor]].
